description: This source file defines a pipeline behavior for handling database transactions within a MediatR request processing pipeline. It manages transaction lifecycle (begin, commit, rollback) around the execution of a request.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>
classes.description: Implements IPipelineBehavior to add transaction management around request handling in MediatR pipeline.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Wraps the execution of the next delegate with transaction management: begins transaction, executes the request, commits if successful or rollbacks if an exception occurs.
